items.title: Epic's Tim Sweeney says Steam's AI rule is "unfair to developers who use AI to make good games"
items.excerpt: Epic CEO Tim Sweeney argues Valve's mandatory Steam generative-AI disclosure is unfair because it associates AI with bad games and treats AI use as binary.

items.title: Ahead of GTA 6, Take-Two CEO calls out Anthropic and OpenAI over AI game clones as it's "ironic" to "stomp on someone else's IP"
items.excerpt: After Claude began blocking users from recreating existing games, Take-Two's Strauss Zelnick says AI labs that protect their own IP while enabling clones of others' games are being ironic, as GTA 6 nears launch.

items.title: Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney predicts AI revolution in gaming with 10X productivity and entirely new genres -- if devs get behind it
items.excerpt: In an exclusive interview, Sweeney says AI could make studios up to 10X more productive, lower the cost of experimentation and spawn new genres, warning studios that refuse it may not be able to compete.

items.title: As low-effort AI slop continues to flood Steam, yet more developers announce game delays caused by Valve's growing approval backlog
items.excerpt: Steam's growing submission review backlog, widely blamed on a flood of low-effort AI-made games, is forcing more indie developers to push back release dates.

items.title: 対話型AI「Claude」が『ポケモン』関連の作業を拒否するようになったとの報告。“ゲーム模倣NG”に加え、「アセット」「ロゴ」の使用も拒む
items.excerpt: Users report Claude now refuses Pokemon-related generation work, declining not only to imitate existing games but also to use their assets and logos.

items.title: Vibecoded Pokemon Fan Project Developer Is Outraged At AI Clampdowns On IP Infringement After Spending Thousands Per Month
items.excerpt: The developer of a Claude-built Pokemon fan game says the project will still ship, but complains the new IP guardrails make it harder to get the AI to build it.

items.title: AI 공격에 54만 동접 국산 스팀 게임 정보 샜다
items.excerpt: 국내 게임 서버 솔루션 '뒤끝'이 취약점을 악용한 'AI 기반 공격'을 받아 스팀 방치형 게임 '태스크바 히어로' 이용자 정보가 23일간 유출됐다.

items.title: 모바일 컨트롤러 세라핌 S3, 하이라이트 AI 녹화 기능 공개
items.excerpt: 세라핌이 엑솔라와 협력해 트위치콘 2026에서 S3 컨트롤러용 'AI 하이라이트'를 공개했다. 콘솔 앱이 플레이 영상을 분석해 공유용 짧은 클립을 자동으로 만든다.

items.title: Why Are Games Hiding Their Blatant AI Usage If They Think It's Totally Cool And Fine And The Future
items.excerpt: Aftermath examines games whose obvious generative-AI assets go undisclosed on Steam despite Valve's AI disclosure policy.

items.title: "It's a wild situation" - An investor and publisher perspective on the rise of AI copycats, the discoverability crisis, and more
items.excerpt: A panel at the AI and Games Conference in London weighed the problems and opportunities AI brings, from AI copycat games to discoverability.

items.title: AI and Games Conference heads to North America with first Montreal event in June 2027
items.excerpt: Game AI Events CIC, the UK body behind the AI and Games Conference, announced its first event outside London, set for June 22-23, 2027 in Montreal.

items.title: Steam's Angriest New Game Is the Perfect Place to Channel Your AI Hate
items.excerpt: Virtue and a Sledgehammer is a new Steam game that rages against AI and finds peace in grief.

items.title: 바르코 1개월 무료 이용권까지, NC AI 첫 밋업 현장
items.excerpt: NC AI가 게임 개발자 커뮤니티 '판교 빌더스' 첫 행사 '빌더스 나잇'을 열고 'AI로 게임 빌드하기'를 주제로 개발자 70여 명과 VARCO 활용 게임 제작 사례를 공유했다. 참가자에게 바르코 1개월 무료 이용권을 줬다.

items.title: 뤼튼, '지스타 2026' 메인 스폰서 참가..."AI 창작 신세계 선보여"
items.excerpt: AI 플랫폼 기업 뤼튼테크놀로지스가 19일 개막하는 지스타 2026 메인 스폰서로 참가해 AI 캐릭터 챗 '크랙' 등 AI 창작 체험을 대형 부스로 선보인다.

items.title: 루미웨이브, '라그나로크 몬스터 마블'에 AI 플레이어 도입 추진
items.excerpt: 루미웨이브가 이용자 요청을 받아 전적을 분석하고 덱 변경이나 자동 대전을 수행하는 AI 비서를 그라비티 IP 기반 캐주얼 전략 게임 '라그나로크 몬스터 마블'에 도입한다.

items.title: 크레딧코인, AI 에이전트 전략 대전 게임 '그리드' 글로벌 베타 시작
items.excerpt: 크레딧코인 생태계 포털 펭귄베이스가 외부 AI 에이전트를 연동해 서로 전략 대결을 벌이는 시뮬레이션 게임 '그리드'의 글로벌 베타를 시작했다.

items.title: Call of Duty Warns AI-Powered Cheats Are Becoming Harder to Detect
items.excerpt: Activision says cheat makers are using AI to build external, screen-reading aim tools that evade traditional detection, and that RICOCHET Anti-Cheat is shifting to behaviour analysis to catch them.

items.title: Cloud and AI accelerate game development innovation at AWS re:Invent 2026
items.excerpt: AWS previews its re:Invent 2026 games track, including an 'Agentic Arcade' and sessions on AI agents and generative AI across game development.

items.title: Following site-wide discussion on AI use, Nexus Mods add a "daily limit" to the spots in the new mods tab one person can hog via multiple rapid-fire uploads
items.excerpt: After its site-wide debate over AI-generated mods, Nexus Mods added an experimental daily limit on how many new-mods-tab spots a single uploader can take within 24 hours.

items.title: Nintendo's legendary Kirby designer Masahiro Sakurai weighs in on gen-AI, saying "it has yet to gain my trust" but not to reject it completely
items.excerpt: Smash Bros. creator Masahiro Sakurai says generative AI has not yet earned his trust or proved useful to him, but argues it should not be ruled out entirely.

items.title: EpicのCEOティム・スウィーニー氏、Steamの生成AI開示は「有害」と語る。ゲームの良し悪しにAIは関係がないと主張
items.excerpt: Epic CEO Tim Sweeney calls Steam's generative-AI disclosure harmful and unfair to developers who use AI to make good games (Japanese coverage of the same remarks).
